ops.en: THE END OF THE TWO YEARS. mi-qetz shenatayim yamim u-faro cholem — the span opens where gen_63's forgetting left off; the open paragraph at mi-qetz (MS: one of the two portions with no break at all inside them) files named.

THE DELAY IS A TERM, NOT AN OVERSIGHT [claim G64-27 context; sources at the seat]. 'He sets an end to darkness' is read twice - a term set for the world's darkness and a term set for this man's, and when the end came, Pharaoh dreamed. The standing credits converge on this one verse: the two-years bill charged for two words of misplaced trust, the king's own river-theology, and the reason for the w…

THE DOUBLY-FULL GRAZING [G64-03]. va-tirena ba-achu — the graze-verb doubly full (yod before the nun, final he), exactly TWICE in the Torah: the dream and its retelling (41:2, 41:18) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-03]. The rising-word olot wears the burnt-offering's doubly-lean skeleton (the Ramah's whole-Torah olah-rule, named).
THE AFTER-THEM WORD [G64-08]. olot ACHAREHEN — the feminine after- them form whose ENTIRE Torah career is this chapter's five tokens (41:3, 6, 19, 27, 30) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-08].

THE FIRST SWALLOW. va-tokhalna — the eat-verb plain here; the retelling will trade it for the swallow-verb (41:24). The Hilleli's lean-file on this verse (the thin-word, the fair-word, the healthy- word) files named.

ONE STALK [G64-12]. sheva shibolim olot BE-QANE ECHAD — the phrase stands exactly THREE times in the Torah: the good ears twice (41:5, 41:22) and the made MENORAH (Exod 37:19) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-12]: the Kitzur — plenty is light for the world; only the good ears share the lamp's phrase.

THE BLASTED. daqot u-shedufot qadim — the Kitzur's contrast: the good on ONE stalk, the blasted on none; the blast-word's spelling ledger (the Ramah's first-full-then-lean rule across 41:6/23/27) files named.

THE SWALLOW AND THE FULL [G64-04/05]. va-TIVLANA — with final he and the bent nun, once so in the Torah (the retelling drops the he and straightens the nun, 41:24) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-04]; ve-ha- MELEOT — the Torah's ONE full fullness-word (every other melet lean; the books that fill 41:22's are in error) [VERIFIED: G64-05]; ha- beriot with the bet dagesheed [G64-13].

THE COURT FAILS. va-tipaem rucho (the troubled-spirit verb's one Torah token) — chalomO singular told, poter OTAM plural failed: the letter counts two dreams where Pharaoh feels one; Joseph will rule them one (41:25).

AN INK CONTRAST GRADED LEG BY LEG [claim G64-22, machine-checked]. The chain contrasts this verse's single-letter spelling of the troubled spirit against the doubled spelling in a later book, and hangs three readings and a timing rule on the difference. OUR LEG IS EXACT: the single form stands exactly once in the whole Torah, here. THE OTHER LEG IS NOT OPENED - that book lies outside this corpus, …

THE FAILED INTERPRETATION IS PRESERVED VERBATIM [claim G64-29]. Seven daughters born and seven buried; seven kingdoms conquered and seven provinces rebelling - the wrong reading recorded in full rather than passed over, which is what lets the right one be demonstrated instead of merely asserted. And the order is read as engineered: they were let to exhaust him first, so that the true reading could…

THE LATE REMEMBERING. et chataay ani MAZKIR ha-yom — the mention- verb of Joseph's remember-demand (40:14, pushed in gen_63 and left open there) finally fires: the cross-unit discharge the machine records in prose — two years of days between the push and the pop. The et of the address in segol per MS [G64-13, named].
THE COMPRESSION. The cupbearer retells gen_63 in three verses (41:10-13), trimming his offense to Pharaoh's wrath; the lean bakers-word here (41:10) closes G63-01's four-station file.
THE FORMULA RETURNED. ish ke-fitron chalomo — the narrator's own grading-phrase (40:5) now in the witness's mouth: the letter lets him quote its own voice.

THE DIMINISHING WITNESS. naar ivri EVED — lad, Hebrew, slave: the reading tradition counts the cupbearer's three belittlings (cursed be the wicked whose favors are half-favors — named); the letter needs one verse to undo them (41:14).

THREE DEMEANINGS IN ONE CLAUSE, AND A FOREIGN LAW CITED AS THE OBSTACLE [claim G64-31]. A lad meaning a fool, a Hebrew meaning an enemy tongue, a slave meaning one who by Pharaoh's own statute books may neither reign nor wear the royal bracelets. The elevation must clear a legal bar the chain states as positive Egyptian law. The confession's motive is audited in the same breath: the king looked ne…
THE WITNESS'S VERIFICATION. ka-asher patar lanu ken haya — 40:22's narrator-clause now sworn by a witness before the king; ka-asher unjoined with the shin stroked per MS [G64-13, named].

THE OPERATIVE RULE AND ITS FLAT DENIAL, BOTH KEPT [claim G64-27]. From 'as he interpreted to us, SO IT WAS' the chain derives that dreams follow the mouth, with the broken-beam case as its worked example - one master reading a son born and living, his students, in his absence, a husband buried: 'you have eliminated a man.' Then R. Abahu denies the premise outright, and the denial stands on the rec…

RUSHED [G64-02]. va-YERITZUHU min ha-bor — full yod, lean vav against the erring prints (the Ramah, the Meiri, every precise manuscript), and the Zohar reads the lean vav: who ran him out? the Holy One — none binds and none looses but He [VERIFIED: manifest G64-02]. va-yechalef simlotav — the cycle's FOURTH garment-turn (coat, veil, cloak, now the shave-and-change): this one upward.
THE VACANCY. u-foter en oto — the court's failure repeated to the candidate's face; tishma chalom — 'you HEAR a dream': Pharaoh's verb for interpretation is listening.
THE DEFLECTION. BILADAY — 'apart from me': the interpreter removes himself before he begins (40:8's le-Elohim pitronim restated before the throne); Elohim yaane et shelom paro.

CHAIN AND TRANSLATION STOP ON THE SAME HALF-VERSE FOR THE SAME REASON. The midrash reads the disclaimer as attributing the greatness to its Owner; Onkelos writes NOT FROM MY WISDOM, and adds the reverence formula - from before the LORD let an answer be given. The buffer names the faculty being disclaimed, which the Hebrew leaves open. Two independent members of the declared reading arriving at one…

THE RETELLING. hineni omed al sefat ha-yeor — the retelling adds the bank underfoot (against 41:1's 'over the Nile'): the variance-file between dream and telling opens (the reading tradition's court- flattery notes file named).
THE PAIR CLOSES [G64-03]. va-tirena ba-achu — the doubly-full graze- verb's second and last token: dream and retelling, census exact.

THE AMPLIFICATION. lo raiti khahena be-khal eretz mitzrayim — the retelling adds what no dream showed: the king's own editorial (dalot 'poor' replacing the dream's raot-mare); Chizkuni's four-hollow-cows tzere note files named [G64-13]. sheva joined to parot by maqqef with the stroke on the shin, per MS (named).
THE EAT KEPT. va-tokhalna — the cows still EAT in the retelling; the ears will SWALLOW (41:24): the letter splits the verbs the dreams shared.

THE ADDITION. ve-lo noda ki vau el qirbena — the whole clause is the retelling's invention (no dream-verse showed it): the king reports his own unknowing as part of the dream; the machine files the delta as letter-fact.

ONE STALK AGAIN [G64-12]. be-qane echad — the phrase's second station; melet here LEAN as the Ramah rules (against the books that fill it — the one full fullness-word stands at 41:7 alone) [G64-05 asserted].

THE ONE MEM [G64-08]. tzomchot ACHAREHEM — the Ramah's own exception: the one after-them with mem inside the chapter of five nuns [VERIFIED via census G64-08; the mem-station asserted]; tzenumot ('withered') — the retelling's added word, its only Torah token.

THE FLIP LANDS [G64-04]. va-TIVLAN — the retelling drops the swallow-verb's he and straightens its nun (against 41:7's bent form): the Ramah's pair complete, each form once [VERIFIED: manifest G64-04, second station asserted]. ve-en magid LI — the court's failure now personal.

ONE. chalom paro ECHAD hu — the interpreter's first word repairs the count (chalomo/otam, 41:8): two showings, one decree. higid le-faro — the Masorah's told/shown pair (41:25/28) with its Samuel sign files named.

THE HILLELI'S LEAN COWS [G64-06]. sheva PAROT ha-tovot — the cows- word lean, marked unique-and-lean: the Hilleli codex lean against the Yerushalmi's full, and HERE the stream sides WITH the Hilleli (its first vindication since the fifth-year split ruled against it). The lean skeleton's Torah-wide collisions: the EUPHRATES four times, and Joseph's own ben porat twice (49:22) — cows, river, and fru…

THE LEAN EVIL [G64-07]. ve-ha-parot ha-raqot ve-HA-RAOT — the evil- plural lean, one of the Torah's TWO (the other: 'after the many to evil', Exod 23:2) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-07]: Pharaoh's cows and the perverted court share the lean skeleton. The famine-word enters the interpretation here.

THE UNIT'S OWN TERM IS A DISPUTED QUANTITY [claim G64-28, opened not credited]. Fourteen, twenty-eight, or forty-two years by three counts of what the telling should generate - against the position that the famine ran TWO years and stopped when Jacob came down, resuming only in the prophet's day. Graded honestly: these are not counts of tokens, so the machine cannot adjudicate them. It records ins…
SHOWN. hera et paro — the told/shown pair completes (41:25 higid, 41:28 hera): the Masorah's file, named.
THE PLENTY. hine sheva shanim baot — the Kitzur's granary-pair on sava (the storehouses filled to bursting, named).

THE FORGETTING FORETOLD. ve-NISHKACH kal ha-sava — the forget-verb of 40:23 (the cupbearer's) now decreed over the plenty itself: what forgot Joseph will be forgotten; the after-them nun-form's fourth token rides 41:27, the fifth at 41:30 [G64-08].
THE UNKNOWN ANSWERED. ve-lo YIVADA ha-sava — the retelling's ve-lo noda (41:21) receives its meaning: the un-knowing was the decree's own clause; the machine notes the delta closed.
THE DOUBLING READ. ki nakhon ha-davar me-im ha-Elohim u-memaher — the interpreter's rule for all doubled dreams (the tradition arms it back onto Joseph's own two, named): established and hastened.

THE UNASKED COUNSEL. ve-ata YERE faro ish navon ve-chakham — the interpreter exceeds his brief: no one asked for advice. The jussive pair (yere, vi-yshitehu) pushed as one demand — and the span discharges it on JOSEPH HIMSELF (41:41): the counsel's demandee unnamed, its satisfaction the counselor. yere end-stressed against the custom, the Masorah's none-other-so (named) [G64-13].

THE PLAN. yaase faro ve-yafqed peqidim — the Kitzur's appoint-pair (Joseph's overseers gathered grain and enriched; Ahasuerus's gathered maidens and impoverished — named): the second counsel- demand, discharged at the gathering (41:48).
THE MECHANICS. ve-yiqbetzu et kal okhel — the Kitzur's gather-pair (grain vs maidens, named); the plan's verbs (gather, pile, guard) will be re-walked verbatim at 41:48-49.
THE DEPOSIT. le-fiqadon — the deposit-noun's only Torah station outside the sancta-law (Lev 5:21-23, named): Egypt's grain filed under trust-law vocabulary.
THE HUMAN TOV. va-yitav ha-davar be-ene faro — like 40:16's bystander-tov, a court's approval, not an oracle verdict: the TEST register stays silent by TIR discipline (letter-note).
THE QUESTION. ish asher RUACH ELOHIM bo — the king's phrase for the vacancy: the spirit-formula the corpus last saw over the waters (1:2); the pagan court names the Name.

THE TRANSLATION RESOLVES WHAT THE CHAIN ONLY PRAISES. The king's phrase 'a man in whom is the spirit of God' is rendered THE SPIRIT OF PROPHECY from before the LORD - the buffer deciding the identity of the gift, where the midrash at this verse reads the clause only as praise and mounts a typology on it. The specifying move the same translator makes at the failing heart in the next block. [folded …
THE WORDS RETURNED. en NAVON VE-CHAKHAM kamokha — Pharaoh hands Joseph's own counsel-words (41:33) back to him: the demandee revealed; the discharge is one verse away.
THE KISS-RULE. ve-al pikha YISHAQ kal ami — the Kitzur's pair: 'lips he kisses who answers right words' (named): for the right answer, the kiss of the whole people. raq ha-kise — the one reservation.

TWO LATER PASSAGES ARE READ BY A RULE TAKEN FROM THIS SPEECH [claim G64-25]. The restrictive particle caps what precedes it - so 'ONLY the throne will I be greater than you' becomes the model for 'you shall be ONLY above' and 'you shall be holy': God's greatness and sanctity stay above Israel's exactly as the king's stays above his viceroy's. Onkelos narrows the same clause to honor and to office,…

THE COUNSEL COMES HOME. ree natati otkha al kal eretz mitzrayim — the look-for-a-man demand discharges: the man is the counselor; Pharaoh's ree answers Joseph's yere (the same see-verb, imperative for jussive — the letter closes the loop in one root). The demandee- mismatch class gains its politest member: advice satisfied by the adviser's own elevation.

THE INVESTITURE. va-yalbesh oto bigde SHESH — the cycle's garments ascend: stripped coat, seized cloak, prison change, now royal linen; the ring (tabaat) debuts the seal-motif the Esther-readers arm (named).

SIX RESTRAINTS, SIX HONORS, MATCHED ONE FOR ONE [claim G64-26]. The mouth that did not kiss is repaid 'at your word shall my people be fed'; the body that did not touch, the linen; the neck that did not bend, the chain; the hands that did not grope, the ring; the feet that did not stride, the chariot; the thought that did not think, being called wise. The exact mirror of the slanders-and-repayment…

THE CRY. va-yiqreu lefanav AVREKH — the herald's word left on the letter (the readings: 'father in wisdom, tender in years' — named, never merged); be-MIRKEVET — 'the only chiriq of its word' per the Masorah [G64-13, named]. The naming-formula va-yiqreu is a crowd's cry, not a registry write (no shem-object): REGISTRY untouched, letter-note.

A WORD WITH NO SECOND SEAT ANYWHERE IN THE CORPUS [claim G64-21, machine-checked]. The chain reads the herald's cry as great in wisdom and tender in years; Onkelos decides it as a title of office - THIS IS THE FATHER TO THE KING. Machine-checked: the word stands exactly ONCE in the entire Torah, at this verse. There is no other occurrence against which any of the three readings could be tested, an…
THE FORMULA. ani faro — the self-naming that seals delegations (the Exodus readers will hear its dark twin, named); u-viladekha — 'without YOU': Joseph's biladay (41:16) inverted by the king.

TWO LIMBS READ AS TWO INSTRUMENTS, IN BOTH MEMBERS OF THE READING. 'No man shall lift his hand or his foot' becomes, in the translation, no man shall raise his hand TO TAKE UP A WEAPON or his foot TO RIDE UPON A HORSE - and 'without you' becomes without YOUR WORD. The chain reads the same idiom the same way at its own seat. Chain-witnessed both ways, and the viceroy's word now governs a realm as i…
THE ENTITY READ. Joseph is a cross-unit presence (installed at his birth, 30:23-24, outside this span): read-before-install, flagged by the machine's own discipline.

THE TWO-WORD NAME [G64-09]. va-yiqra faro shem yosef TZAFNAT PANEACH — 'one name, written and read as two words' (the Ramah; the old chumash: they must share one line) — and SNAPSHOT carries the pair as two unjoined tokens, as it carries POTI FERA with no maqqef between (the precise books, Yerushalmi Megilla, Soferim) [VERIFIED: manifest G64-09]: the mirror of Potiphar-the-one-word (G62-01). REGIS…

A NAME DISSOLVED INTO A FUNCTION, A SACRAL TITLE DENIED TO A FOREIGN SHRINE [claim G64-30]. Onkelos does not transliterate the Egyptian name; it TRANSLATES it - the man to whom hidden things are revealed - and at both its seats renders the father-in-law's priestly title as a civil chief. Two guards in one clause. The chain's own letter-table on the same name stands beside it, reading the syllables…
THE COUNT. ben sheloshim shana — seventeen at the sale (37:2), thirty at the throne: the letter's own thirteen-year ledger; melekh with the mem stroked per MS [G64-13, named].
THE HANDFULS. li-qematzim — the plenty's one-word measure; the priestly handful (qometz) sleeps in it for the Leviticus readers (named).

THE ONE SEAT WHERE THE PLENTY IS A PROGRAM AND NOT A GIFT [claim G64-33]. The chain reads the handfuls as reaping straight to the mill and as savings; Onkelos moves the subject itself - THE INHABITANTS OF THE LAND STORED UP grain for storehouses. The yield becomes a human act. A genuine divergence, and the register the unit's storage operators actually run in. Beside it the storage law that each l…

THE PLAN EXECUTED. va-yiqbotz et kal okhel — 41:34-35's verbs re- walked (gather, give, guard): the second counsel-demand discharges with Joseph again as its own executor. asher HAYU — the was/were pair (41:48 hayu / 41:53 haya), one of the Masorah's three such pairs, the Ezekiel sign named [G64-13, asserted].

THE SIMILE. ke-CHOL HA-YAM — the promise-simile (22:17, 32:13) spent on Egyptian grain by the man who carries the promise; ad ki chadal li-sepor: the counting stops where the blessing-language begins.

BEN ASHER'S PATACH [G64-01]. u-le-yosef YULAD — MS found every book with qamatz, and the variance-lists call that Ben Naphtali's reading, patach Ben Asher's; SNAPSHOT writes the PATACH: the stream with BEN ASHER against every book MS saw — the corpus's second Ben Asher/Ben Naphtali station (with yehi or), Ben Asher both times [VERIFIED: manifest G64-01]. And u-le-yosef stands exactly TWICE in the …

A LAW RESTING ON THIS UNIT'S OWN TIME-STAMP [claim G64-24]. The rule that intercourse is forbidden in a time of famine is grounded in this verse - two sons born BEFORE the year of famine came. The clause is in our ink exactly as the rule requires, with the births placed on the prior side of it. A credit standing since the corpus's sixteenth block named this verse as its forward seat; the seat is n…
THE FIRSTBORN. va-yiqra yosef et shem ha-bekhor.

NAMED FOR FORGETTING. ki NASHANI Elohim et kal amali — the name- sentence conjugates the chapter's forget-verb (40:23 the cupbearer, 41:30 the plenty, now the toil): three forgettings, and only this one is called a mercy. REGISTRY write 2.
THE SECOND. ve-et shem ha-sheni qara.

NAMED FOR FRUIT. ki HIFRANI Elohim be-eretz anyi — the fruitful-verb of the covenant blessings (17:6, 28:3, 35:11) conjugated over Egypt; anyi with the ayin in qamatz alone [G64-13]. REGISTRY write 3 — the span's registry closes: one renaming by a king, two namings by the renamed.
ENDED. va-tikhlena — the finish-verb of the heavens (2:1, gen_07's crown) closes Egypt's plenty; asher HAYA — the pair's singular half [G64-13, asserted].

THE ECONOMY'S SEAM PRICED AT A VERB [claim G64-23]. The years of plenty 'were completed' - read as emerging whole; the years of famine 'began' - read as entering already ill, hunger on the first day though they had eaten on the last. Verified at the ink: adjacent verses, the same feminine-plural shape, the difference exactly the one consonant the reading rests on. [folded shape: ink count]

AS JOSEPH SAID. ka-asher AMAR yosef — the letter's verification- clause again (40:22's pattern at kingdom scale); lavo written FULL against the careless copies (MS: 'who writes it lean does not well' — named). ha-aratzot under the books' galgal, SNAPSHOT's munach — station 9 [VERIFIED: manifest G64-10].

THE GO-COMMAND. lekhu el yosef asher yomar lakhem taasu — Pharaoh's open-ended transfer: go, and DO whatever he says; the reading tradition's circumcision-teaching on taasu files named (the Kitzur's letter-sum). Pushed on all Egypt.

A CONVERSION CONDITION READ INTO A FOOD ADMINISTRATION [claim G64-34]. 'What he says to you, do' is read as a compulsion to circumcise before buying, with a second proof drawn from an extra letter in a later verse read as life in this world and the next. The exchange is staged in full - the appeal to Pharaoh, his rebuke that seven years of warning were ignored, and their answer that what they stor…

THE OPENING. va-yiftach yosef et kal asher bahem — the sell-grain verb (va-yishbor) opens the shever-vocabulary the next unit lives in; the Ramah: every such sell-word in the Torah LEAN (the erring Masorah-note corrected — named). al under tifcha without maqqef [G64-13]; chazaq's zayin in patach [G64-13].

THE FAMINE IS GIVEN A DISTRIBUTION, AND THE WORD CARRIES IT [claim G64-34]. 'On the FACE of all the earth' is read to mean it began with the WEALTHY, since only the moneyed have a face to show. Around it the withholder-and-provider mapping: the one the nation curses is the king, the one blessed on the head is the administrator - the political verdict on a food supply drawn from a proverb. [folded …

THE WORLD COMES. ve-khal ha-aretz bau mitzrayma lishbor el yosef — the go-command discharges beyond its demandees: pushed on Egypt, satisfied by ALL THE EARTH — the span's last demandee-overshoot, and the door the brothers will walk through in the next unit. The machine ends with an empty queue: every demand of the chapter discharged — the first clean board since the forward era began.

A FACULTY DECLARED LOST AT AN EARLIER BLOCK, STILL LOST AT THIS ONE [claim G64-32]. From the day the son was taken the Divine Spirit left the father: he would see without seeing and hear without hearing - which is how he can 'SEE there was grain in Egypt' without being there, and how his 'go down' can be an unwitting prophecy. The same passage builds the apparatus that will find the brothers: name…
